runs_empty: You have no runs yet. Create the first one.
pokedex_soon: The Pokédex arrives with a later version.
auth_to_register: Have an invitation? Create an account
auth_to_login: Already have an account? Sign in
auth_error_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth_error_account_disabled: This account is disabled. Ask the administrator.
auth_error_registration_closed: Registration is closed. Ask the administrator for an account.
auth_error_invite_invalid: The invitation is not valid. Ask for a new link.
auth_error_email_taken: This email already has an account.
auth_error_validation: Check the fields and try again.
profile_password_saved: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
change_password_intro: This account was created with a password set by the administrator. Choose your own before you continue.
change_password_error_same: The new password must be different from the current one.
admin_mode_open: Open: anyone can create an account
admin_mode_closed: Closed: only the administrator creates accounts
admin_invite_once: Copy the link now: it is shown only once.
admin_temporary_password: Temporary password: {password}. Give it to the person: it is shown only once and they must change it at the next sign-in.
admin_http_warning: You are using HTTP: passwords and sessions travel unencrypted. Set up a certificate or an HTTPS reverse proxy.
admin_error_last_admin: The app needs at least one active administrator.
admin_error_self: You cannot do this to your own account.
admin_pokedex: Pokédex: PokéAPI data from commit {commit}, generated on {date}.
admin_pokedex_missing: The Pokédex file has not been generated.
admin_confirm_delete: Delete this account? The person's name, email and password are removed; their runs stay. This cannot be undone.
runs_always_on: Always on: one encounter per area, a fainted Pokémon is dead, nickname required, linked partners share their fate, and an area is skipped for everyone if one player misses the encounter.
runs_locked_notice: The game, the difficulty, the dupes clause, the primary type restriction, gifts and inner rooms cannot be changed after the first encounter.
runs_rule_dupes_hint: If a player already has the evolutionary line of the species met, even dead, only that player gets another try.
runs_rule_type_hint: No repeated primary types in the team.
runs_rule_gifts: Gifts, fixed encounters and trades as separate encounters
runs_rule_gifts_hint: They do not use up the encounter of the area.
runs_rule_rooms_hint: Each inner room of a cave has its own encounter.
runs_rule_randomizer_hint: No encounter tables: the species is picked from the Pokédex.
runs_rule_calculator_hint: Show the damage calculator in the run.
runs_error_validation: Check the name (1 to 60 characters) and the game.
runs_error_difficulty: This game has no difficulty setting.
runs_spectator_banner: You are a spectator: you can see everything, but not change it.
runs_ended_banner: This run is over: it can be read, but not changed.
runs_invite_invalid: This invitation does not work. Ask the owner of the run for a new link.
runs_invite_already: You are already part of this run.
runs_invite_declined: Invitation declined. The seat stays open.
runs_invite_app: This is an invitation to the app: create your account to start.
runs_error_already_member: You are already part of this run.
runs_error_run_not_active: This run is over: nobody can join it.
runs_error_invite_invalid: This invitation does not work any more.
runs_invite_seat_name: Name of the seat (leave empty for an open link)
runs_invite_link_once: Copy this link now: it is shown only once.
runs_member_remove_confirm: Remove this person from the run? Their data stay.
runs_member_transfer_confirm: Hand the run to this person? You become a player.
runs_member_leave_confirm: Leave this run? Your data stay, but you will not see it any more.
runs_error_last_owner: The owner cannot be removed or demoted: hand the run to another player first.
runs_error_invite_form: Check the name (it must be different from the others) and the number of uses.
runs_seats_hint: Each person gets an invitation link. You can invite more people later.
runs_error_no_player: At least one player is needed: tick «I play too» or add a player.
runs_links_hint: Send each link to its person. They are shown only now.
